msgStgAboutDesc: is a yaiol Rust app template.
msgStgFfmpegCheckFailed: Could not reach yaiol to check for the latest version.
msgStgFfmpegExplain: Downloads ffmpeg {version} (about {size} MB) from {source} and installs it for all yaiol apps.
tipMainAdd: Add the links from the clipboard
tipMainClear: Remove the finished downloads from the list
msgMainListEmpty: Copy a link, then press + at the top. A playlist becomes one row per video.
tipMainPresetVideo: Used for a link to a video: the picture and the sound, in which form
tipMainPresetAudio: Used for a link to sound only (SoundCloud and the like): in which form
tipMainFolder: The folder the downloads go to
tipMainOverwrite: What to do when the file is already in the folder
tipMainShowFile: Show the file in its folder
msgMainToolsMissing: yt-dlp and ffmpeg are being installed. Downloading starts as soon as they are.
msgStgYtdlpCheckFailed: Could not reach GitHub to check for the latest version.
msgStgYtdlpExplain: Downloads yt-dlp {version} from GitHub and installs it for all yaiol apps.
msgStgDenoCheckFailed: Could not reach GitHub to check for the latest version.
msgStgDenoExplain: Downloads Deno {version} from GitHub and installs it for all yaiol apps. YouTube videos need it.
msgMngReorderHint: Drag an entry to change the order. The same order is used in the lists of the window.
lblStgLogin: Use my browser's login when a site asks for one
msgStgLoginExplain: Only when a video needs you signed in (age-restricted, members-only): yt-dlp reads that site's login from a browser on this PC, Firefox first. Nothing else is read, and it goes nowhere but to that site.
msgDstNameHint: Click a name to add it. A slash makes a sub-folder.
msgStgCookiesExplain: A cookies.txt exported from a browser where you are signed in. Used first, only when a video needs you signed in. It is your login: keep it private and delete it when you are done.
msgStgTagExplain: Adds the title, artist, album, track number, genre, year and cover to the sound files you download, and the page address as the comment. If the file already carries a Suno id in its comment, the id is also copied to the YAIOL_AIID tag before the comment is replaced. The album and the track number are only known for a set on a music site such as SoundCloud.
msgDstSetFolderHint: When you add a set (a playlist or an album), its files go into a sub-folder named after the set.
msgDstSetPatternHint: Click a name to add it. set is the title of the album or playlist, year and date are when it came out (when the site says), uploader is who published it. A name the site does not give is left out.
